user.title: Connect your Elfin Flip
user.description: Turn on your Elfin Flip WK03C and enter its local address. Home Assistant checks its power state and can put it in standby.

data_description.host: Enter the projector's address on your local network, without http://, a port, or a path.

reconfigure.title: Update the projector address
reconfigure.description: Turn on the projector and enter its current address. The integration checks that it is the same projector before updating the connection.

data_description.host: Enter the new local address of the projector already configured in this integration.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the projector. Turn it on, check its address and local network connection, then try again.
error.invalid_device: The address did not return a valid XGIMI Elfin Flip WK03C device description. Check the address and projector model.
error.different_device: This address belongs to a different projector. Enter the address of the original projector, or add the other projector separately.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The projector address has been updated.
